lines.text: Who is the person you admire most?
lines.cn: 你最敬佩的人是谁?

lines.text: Tu Youyou, who discovered a new medicine for malaria.
lines.cn: 屠呦呦,她发现了一种治疗疟疾的新药。

lines.text: Why do you admire her so much?
lines.cn: 你为什么这么敬佩她?

lines.text: Because she never gave up, even after many failures.
lines.cn: 因为即使屡次失败,她也从不放弃。

lines.text: What do you think makes a person great?
lines.cn: 你觉得是什么让一个人伟大?

lines.text: Not fame or money, but caring about others.
lines.cn: 不是名利,而是关心他人。

lines.text: I agree. Courage matters too.
lines.cn: 我同意。勇气也很重要。

lines.text: Yes, and never giving up when things are hard.
lines.cn: 对,还有遇到困难时永不放弃。

grammarQuiz.q:
He ______ penicillin.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

The ______ tells us about Alexander Fleming, who discovered penicillin. 1 We were very impressed by the old man.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

He was not ______ to acknowledge defeat. 2 Afterwards, Einstein had to flee Germany.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

Hitler was in power ______. 3 There is nothing we can do to help Linda.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Tu Youyou was a patient scientist who never gave up. After failing more than a hundred and ninety times, her team finally found a new medicine for malaria. When she won the Nobel Prize, she shared the honour with her whole team.
reading.passageCn: 屠呦呦是一位有耐心、从不放弃的科学家。在失败190多次后,她的团队终于找到了一种治疗疟疾的新药。当她获得诺贝尔奖时,她把荣誉与整个团队分享。

questions.q: What kind of scientist was Tu Youyou?
What did she do when she won the prize?
opts: She kept the honour for herself.
She shared the honour with her team.

writing.prompt: Write about a person of achievement you admire. Say who the person is, why he or she is great, and how you feel.
writing.promptCn: 写一位你敬佩的杰出人物:此人是谁、为何伟大、你的感受(试着用非限制性定语从句 …, who/which…)。

quizQuestions.q: His research played a ____ role in treating malaria.（至关重要的)
She would not ____ defeat after many failures.（认输:acknowledge/accept defeat)
He made numerous ____ to modern physics.（贡献)
As a young man, Lu Xun decided to ____ medical school.（退出)
Tu Youyou, ____ discovered artemisinin, won the Nobel Prize.
The book, ____ was published in 2015, tells Einstein's story.
She failed more than 190 times, ____ would have stopped most people.
Einstein, ____ hair often stood on end, looked a little odd.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
quizQuestions.audio: She cared for the wounded soldiers.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他获得了物理学博士学位。
quizQuestions.audio: He earned a doctorate in physics.

listeningQuestions.audio: Tu Youyou discovered a new medicine for malaria.
opts: 屠呦呦发现了一种治疗疟疾的新药。
屠呦呦放弃了她的研究。

listeningQuestions.audio: Einstein was not only a genius but also a kind man.
opts: 爱因斯坦只是个普通人。
爱因斯坦不仅是天才,也是个善良的人。
爱因斯坦从不帮助别人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Florence Nightingale founded modern nursing.
opts: 南丁格尔是一名科学家。
南丁格尔害怕生病的人。
南丁格尔创立了现代护理学。

listeningQuestions.audio: Zhong Nanshan stayed calm and told people the truth.
opts: 钟南山保持冷静并告诉人们真相。

listeningQuestions.audio: She never gave up after failing many times.
opts: 她屡次失败后从不放弃。
她第一次失败就放弃了。

listeningQuestions.audio: We should become a person of value, not just a person of success.
opts: 我们应该做有价值的人,而非只追求成功。

finalReading.passage: Wu Mengchao was a Chinese doctor who kept performing difficult operations even when he was over ninety years old. He believed that as long as his hands were steady, he should keep helping his patients. Many young doctors looked up to him, not only for his great skill but also for his deep love of his work.

questions.q: What was unusual about Wu Mengchao as a doctor?
options: He stopped working when he was young.
He still did hard operations in his nineties.
He never treated any patients.
He only taught and never operated.
questions.explanation: 原文 'kept performing difficult operations even when he was over ninety years old' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: Why did young doctors look up to him?
options: Because he was very rich.
Because he was famous on television.
Because of his great ability and his strong passion for his job.
Because he gave them money.
questions.explanation: 末句 'not only for his great skill but also for his deep love of his work'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

lines.text: My family just moved into a smart home.
lines.cn: 我家刚搬进一座智能家居。

lines.text: Really? What can it do that an ordinary house cannot?
lines.cn: 真的吗?它有什么普通房子做不到的?

lines.text: It locks the door for us when we forget, and saves energy too.
lines.cn: 我们忘锁门时它会替我们锁,还能省电。

lines.text: Amazing! This time next year, I will be living in one as well.
lines.cn: 太棒了!明年此时,我也要住进一座这样的房子。

lines.text: What do you predict the world will be like in 2050?
lines.cn: 你预测2050年的世界会是什么样?

lines.text: I think driverless cars will be taking us everywhere.
lines.cn: 我想无人驾驶汽车会载我们去各处。

lines.text: One challenge will be deciding who is to blame in an accident.
lines.cn: 一个难题会是出事故时如何判定责任。

lines.text: True, but I'd rather welcome the change than resist it.
lines.cn: 没错,但我宁愿欢迎这种变化,而不是抵制它。

grammarQuiz.q:
He ______ born in Guangzhou, China. 6 I was asked to explain the project with the help of a flow chart.

It was a ______ challenge for me. 3 Work in groups.

（跨文化交际句型 · 教材原句）

Complete the ______ using non-restrictive relative clauses to give extra information.

（跨文化交际句型 · 教材原句）

Then share them ______ your group members.

（跨文化交际句型 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: In the not-too-distant future, your home will know your daily routine. The instant you walk in, the lights will come on, your favourite music will start, and dinner will be ready for you. Such a home keeps you secure and saves you energy at the same time.
reading.passageCn: 在不太遥远的将来,你的家会了解你的日常作息。你一进门,灯就会亮起,你最喜欢的音乐会响起,晚饭也已为你准备好。这样的家同时保障你的安全并为你节省能源。

questions.q: What happens the instant you walk into this future home?
opts: The lights come on and music starts.
All the doors lock you out.
You have to cook dinner yourself.

questions.q: What two things does such a home do at the same time?
opts: It wastes energy and makes noise.
It keeps you secure and saves energy.
It calls your friends and orders food.
It cleans the streets and the garden.

writing.prompt: Write a short letter (about 60 words) to your future self, predicting how technology will change your daily life. Use 'will be doing' at least once.
writing.promptCn: 给未来的自己写一封约60词的短信,预测科技将如何改变你的日常生活。至少用一次将来进行时(will be doing)。

quizQuestions.q: Smart homes use integrated ____ to tell when you leave home each morning.
If a water pipe starts to leak, the home will ____ the problem at once.
Some people ____ the idea of developing driverless cars, calling them dangerous.
Change can be scary; ____, I always look on the positive side.
This time tomorrow, I ____ on a plane to the technology fair.
At 8 pm tonight, the family ____ dinner cooked by their robot.
____ you ____ the computer tonight, or may I use it for my essay?
This time next week she ____ in Beijing; she is still in Melbourne now.
听句子选中文:
opts: 未来我们将用先进技术自动控制家中几乎一切。
我们昨天修好了所有的开关。
这座房子从不需要任何电。
quizQuestions.audio: In the future, we will be using advanced technology for automatic control of just about everything in our home.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 机器人决定不再工作了。
明年此时,更多人将乘坐无人驾驶汽车出行。
汽车都被停在了车库里。
人们更喜欢步行去上班。
quizQuestions.audio: This time next year, more people will be travelling in driverless cars to work.

listeningQuestions.audio: In the future, we will be living in smart homes that lock the door for us.
opts: 未来我们将住在能替我们锁门的智能家居里。
未来我们将自己动手修理房门。
过去人们住在没有门锁的房子里。
我们现在正在建造一座新房子。

listeningQuestions.audio: This time tomorrow, the family will be having dinner cooked by a robot.
opts: 这家人昨天吃了一顿大餐。
明天这个时候,这家人将吃着机器人做的晚饭。
这家人正在学习如何做饭。
机器人拒绝为这家人做饭。

listeningQuestions.audio: Scientists predict that driverless cars will be common one day soon.
opts: 科学家说无人驾驶汽车永远不会出现。
司机们都很喜欢开自己的车。
科学家预测无人驾驶汽车不久将会很普遍。
这些汽车今天就已遍布全城。

listeningQuestions.audio: If a water pipe leaks, the smart home will detect it and warn you at once.
opts: 如果停电,房子会自己关灯。
如果有人敲门,房子会自动开门。
如果天气变冷,房子会升温。
如果水管漏水,智能家居会立刻察觉并提醒你。

listeningQuestions.audio: Tiny robots may one day help doctors by working inside the human body.
opts: 微型机器人也许有一天能在人体内协助医生。
大型机器只能在工厂里使用。
医生们决定不再使用任何机器。
机器人正在医院外面排队。

listeningQuestions.audio: I will always look on the positive side of change and accept it rather than resist it.
opts: 我总是害怕任何变化并加以拒绝。
我会一直看变化积极的一面,选择接受而非抵制。
我从不关心未来会发生什么。
我打算停止使用一切新技术。

finalReading.passage: When Mia first heard that her future home would do the housework by itself, she found the idea a little frightening. Yet after living there for a month, she could not imagine going back, because the house quietly saved her time and kept her safe. She now tells her friends that the smartest thing about new technology is the way it gives people more hours to spend with the ones they love.

questions.q: How did Mia feel about the smart home at first?
options: She found the idea rather frightening.
She was sure she would love it.
She thought it was boring.
She wanted to sell it at once.
questions.explanation: 原文 'she found the idea a little frightening' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What does Mia now tell her friends?
options: That technology is a waste of money.
That the best thing is the extra time it gives for loved ones.
That she misses her old house.
That robots should do all the work for everyone.
questions.explanation: 末句 'gives people more hours to spend with the ones they love'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

dialogues.title: Asking the Way to the Fountain

lines.text: Excuse me, do you know where the fountain is?
lines.cn: 打扰一下,你知道喷泉在哪里吗?

lines.text: Yes, it's on the north side, about two hundred metres away.
lines.cn: 知道,在北侧,大约两百米远。

lines.text: How do I get there?
lines.cn: 我怎么过去呢?

lines.text: Follow the path along the river, and you'll see it behind a small bridge.
lines.cn: 沿着河边的小路走,你会在一座小桥后面看到它。

lines.text: Let's go to the wetland park this weekend.
lines.cn: 这周末我们去湿地公园吧。

lines.text: Great! We can take a boat tour and watch the birds.
lines.cn: 太好了!我们可以坐船游览,还能观鸟。

lines.text: And the trees and flowers there are so beautiful.
lines.cn: 而且那里的树木和花朵都很美。

lines.text: It really is the green lungs of our city.
lines.cn: 它真不愧是我们城市的绿肺。

grammarQuiz.q:
______ Dr Wang Wang Le Anna Smith Alexander Fleming Zhong Nanshan Florence Nightingale Wu Mengchao Tu Youyou Dr Wang 3 Listen again and answer the questions below.

（科技主题语法 · 教材原句）

You ______ discuss them with a partner. 1 Why did Anna meet Wang Le at her home?

（科技主题语法 · 教材原句）

Listen for ______ 2 Why did Dr Wang decide to become a doctor?

（科技主题语法 · 教材原句）

After ______ graduated, she worked at th

（科技主题语法 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: A national park is not a playground; it is a safe home for nature and for people who accept nature on its own terms. In such a place, hunting and new building are usually banned so that rare animals and plants can live in peace.
reading.passageCn: 国家公园不是游乐场,而是大自然以及那些愿意按自然法则与之相处的人的安全家园。在这样的地方,狩猎和新建筑通常被禁止,好让珍稀的动植物得以安然生活。

questions.q: What is a national park described as?
opts: A safe home for nature and people.
A place to build new houses.

questions.q: Why are hunting and new building usually banned?
opts: So rare animals and plants can live in peace.
So more cars can come in.

writing.prompt: Introduce or recommend a park you like in about 60 words: its name and location, two things to see or do there, and why you recommend it.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词介绍或推荐一座你喜欢的公园:名称与地点、两项看点或活动,以及推荐理由。

quizQuestions.q: 公园里禁止狩猎,'禁止'用哪个词?
辽阔的、巨大的,用哪个词?
偏远的、遥远的,用哪个词?
值得做的、有益的,用哪个词?
____ matters most in a national park is the protection of nature.
It is important ____ we protect parks for the future.
quizQuestions.point: 主语从句·it 形式主语

quizQuestions.q: ____ we should develop a place like Sarek is still under discussion.
____ the Sami still follow their reindeer surprises many tourists.
听句子选意思:
quizQuestions.audio: Please follow the main path to the bridge.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选意思:
opts: 这座新公园几乎是旧公园的四倍大。
新公园比旧公园小一半。
quizQuestions.audio: The new park is nearly four times larger than the old one.

listeningQuestions.audio: The fountain is on the north side of the park.
Follow the main path along the river until you see a bridge.
opts: 沿着河边主路一直走,直到看到一座桥。

listeningQuestions.audio: All new building is banned within the park boundaries.
opts: 公园边界内禁止新建任何建筑。
公园里正在修很多新楼。

listeningQuestions.audio: Every spring a few Sami still follow their reindeer into the valleys.
opts: 每年春天仍有少数萨米人跟着驯鹿走进山谷。
萨米人冬天才进山打猎。
萨米人再也不养驯鹿了。

listeningQuestions.audio: You can rent a pedal boat right next to the fountain.
opts: 你可以在喷泉旁边租一条脚踏船。
脚踏船只能在湖对岸租。

listeningQuestions.audio: Because it cleans water and makes oxygen, people call it the green lungs.
opts: 因为它净化水、产生氧气,人们叫它绿肺。
因为它很大,人们叫它绿色海洋。
因为树是绿的,人们叫它绿园。
因为空气脏,人们不去那里。

finalReading.passage: When Mia first hiked into the remote park, the heavy bag and the long, pathless climb almost made her want to turn back. Instead of giving up, she rested often and kept moving slowly towards the valley on the far side. By evening she reached a quiet camp under a wide sky, and she felt proud that her hard effort had brought her to such a beautiful, wild place.

questions.q: What did Mia do instead of turning back?
options: She took frequent breaks and pressed on towards her goal.
She left the park and went home at once.
She threw away her heavy bag.
She waited for a car to pick her up.
questions.explanation: 原文 'she rested often and kept moving slowly towards the valley' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mia feel by the evening?
options: Sorry that she had ever started.
Proud that her effort had taken her there.
Bored by the quiet camp.
Afraid of the wide sky.
questions.explanation: 末句 'she felt proud that her hard effort had brought her to such a beautiful, wild place'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

lines.text: You're frowning. Is everything OK?
lines.cn: 你在皱眉,一切还好吗?

lines.text: How did you know? I didn't say anything.
lines.cn: 你怎么知道的?我什么都没说。

lines.text: Your body language told me. Your shoulders are slumped too.
lines.cn: 你的肢体语言告诉了我,你的肩膀也垮着。

lines.text: You're right. Thanks for noticing — talking about it does help.
lines.cn: 你说得对。谢谢你注意到——说出来确实有帮助。

grammarQuiz.q:
He ______ penicillin.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

The ______ tells us about Alexander Fleming, who discovered penicillin. 1 We were very impressed by the old man.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

He was not ______ to acknowledge defeat. 2 Afterwards, Einstein had to flee Germany.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: When Lucy moved to a new country, she could not speak the language at all. Instead of staying silent, she used simple gestures to greet people, ask for help and say thank you. A few months later, she had made many friends, proving that a smile and a kind gesture can speak louder than words.
reading.passageCn: 露西搬到一个新国家时,完全不会说当地语言。她没有保持沉默,而是用简单的手势来问候、求助和道谢。几个月后,她交了许多朋友,这证明微笑和友善的手势胜过千言万语。

questions.q: What did Lucy use to communicate at first?
What did Lucy do instead of staying silent?
opts: She used gestures to greet and ask for help.
She only spoke her own language.

questions.q: What does Lucy's story prove?
opts: A smile and a kind gesture can speak louder than words.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a gesture you often use. Say what it means and how people might understand it differently. Use at least one -ing form (gerund).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一个你常用的手势:它表示什么、别人可能怎样理解。至少用一个动名词(-ing)。

quizQuestions.q: A wave of the hand is a common ____ for saying goodbye.
It is hard to ____ a real smile from a fake one.
Your face often ____ your true feelings before you speak.
A loud phone can easily ____ students from the lesson.
She enjoys ____ about body language in different cultures.
We look forward to ____ how gestures differ around the world.
You should avoid ____ this gesture in Brazil, as it is not polite.
The crucial thing is ____ body language in a way that suits the culture.
听句子选中文:
opts: 同一手势在不同国家可能含义不同。
quizQuestions.audio: The same gesture can mean different things in different countries.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 盯着别人看太久没有问题。
盯着别人看太久可能被当作威胁。
盯着别人看是一种问候。
quizQuestions.audio: Staring at someone too long can be interpreted as a threat.

listeningQuestions.audio: Body language varies from culture to culture.
opts: 肢体语言全世界都一样。

listeningQuestions.audio: Making eye contact can show interest and honesty.
opts: 眼神接触能表现兴趣和真诚。

listeningQuestions.audio: A warm smile can break down barriers between strangers.
opts: 温暖的微笑能打破陌生人之间的隔阂。

listeningQuestions.audio: In Japan, lowering your eyes can demonstrate respect.
opts: 在日本要一直直视长辈。
在日本低目可以表达尊重。

listeningQuestions.audio: Worried students often cross their arms in front of their chests.
opts: 焦虑的学生常把双臂抱在胸前。
焦虑的学生总是大声说话。

listeningQuestions.audio: When in doubt, watch how the local people behave.
opts: 拿不准时观察当地人怎么做。

finalReading.passage: On his first day in Japan, Mark waved at an older man and looked straight into his eyes for a long time. The man seemed uneasy, so a friend quietly explained that lowering the eyes can show respect there. After that, Mark watched the local people and copied their gestures, and soon he felt much more at home.

questions.q: Why did the older man seem uneasy?
options: Mark spoke too loudly to him.
Mark held long, direct eye contact with him.
Mark refused to greet him.
Mark could not find his house.
questions.explanation: 原文 'looked straight into his eyes for a long time' + 朋友解释当地低目示敬,故直视让对方不安;其余未提或相反。

questions.q: What did Mark do after the friend's explanation?
options: He observed the locals and followed their gestures.
He decided to leave Japan at once.
He kept staring at everyone he met.
He stopped talking to anyone.
questions.explanation: 末句 'watched the local people and copied their gestures'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

lines.text: Why are these vegetables more expensive?
lines.cn: 这些蔬菜为什么更贵?

lines.text: Because they are organic, grown without any chemicals.
lines.cn: 因为它们是有机的,种植时不用任何化学品。

lines.text: Are they really better for us?
lines.cn: 它们对我们真的更好吗?

lines.text: Yes. They keep the soil clean and often have more flavour.
lines.cn: 是的。它们能保持土壤洁净,而且味道往往更好。

grammarQuiz.q:
He ______ penicillin.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

The ______ tells us about Alexander Fleming, who discovered penicillin. 1 We were very impressed by the old man.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

He was not ______ to acknowledge defeat. 2 Afterwards, Einstein had to flee Germany.

（非谓语动词 · 教材原句）

Hitler was in power ______. 3 There is nothing we can do to help Linda.

reading.passage: Yuan Longping was called the father of hybrid rice. Although he became famous and wealthy, he still thought of himself as a simple farmer who loved the land. His only wish was to grow enough food so that no one would go hungry.
reading.passageCn: 袁隆平被称为杂交水稻之父。尽管他出了名也变得富有,但他仍把自己看作一个热爱土地的普通农民。他唯一的愿望就是种出足够的粮食,让没有人挨饿。

questions.q: What was Yuan Longping known as?
How did Yuan see himself?
opts: As a simple farmer who loved the land.

questions.q: What was Yuan's only wish?
opts: To grow enough food so no one would go hungry.

writing.prompt: In about 60 words, say whether you support organic farming or chemical farming, and give one reason with a detail.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词说明你支持有机农业还是化学农业,并给出一条理由和一个细节。

quizQuestions.q: 杂交水稻产量高于常规作物,这里'产量'用哪个词?
不用化学品、靠自然方式种庄稼的农业叫什么?
'解决粮食危机'中'解决(难题)'用哪个动词?
'授粉、传粉'对应的英文是?
____ rice feeds millions of people.（句首主语)
It is no use ____ over a poor harvest.
There is no point ____ chemicals if they ruin the soil.
Yuan's ____ the first hybrid rice changed farming forever.
听句子选中文:
opts: 他把一生献给了中国的农民。
quizQuestions.audio: He devoted his whole life to the farmers of China.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 这些化学品会在土壤里残留很长时间。
化学品让庄稼味道更好。
quizQuestions.audio: These chemicals can stay in the soil for a long time.

listeningQuestions.audio: Growing rice feeds millions of people around the world.
opts: 种植水稻养活着全世界数百万人。
大米是世界上最贵的食物。

listeningQuestions.audio: Yuan Longping developed the first hybrid rice for farming.
opts: 袁隆平发明了第一台农用机器。
袁隆平培育出第一种可用于耕作的杂交水稻。
袁隆平种了第一片小麦田。
袁隆平开了第一家米店。

listeningQuestions.audio: Organic farming means growing crops without chemicals.
opts: 有机农业用最多的化学品。
有机农业只在盐碱地里进行。
有机农业指不用化学品种庄稼。

listeningQuestions.audio: Healthy crops need rich and clean soil.
opts: 健康的庄稼需要很多杀虫剂。
健康的庄稼需要肥沃洁净的土壤。

listeningQuestions.audio: Changing crops every year keeps the soil rich in minerals.
opts: 每年更换作物能让土壤富含矿物质。
每年更换作物会毁掉土地。
每年只种同一种作物最好。
更换作物会让庄稼变小。

listeningQuestions.audio: His dream was to keep all people away from hunger.
opts: 他的梦想是变成最富有的人。
他的梦想是让所有人远离饥饿。
他的梦想是不再种水稻。

finalReading.passage: When Mei first moved to the village, she knew nothing about farming and felt useless in the fields. Instead of giving up, she watched the older farmers closely and learned a little more each day. A year later, she could grow her own vegetables and even taught new helpers, proud of how far her patient effort had carried her.

questions.q: What did Mei do instead of giving up?
options: She watched experienced farmers and learned a little every day.
She left the village at once.
She refused to enter the fields again.
She bought all her food from a shop.
questions.explanation: 原文 'watched the older farmers closely and learned a little more each day' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mei feel a year later?
options: Useless and discouraged.
Proud of what her patient effort had achieved.
Sorry that she had ever started.
Bored with growing vegetables.
questions.explanation: 末句 'proud of how far her patient effort had carried her'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

lines.text: What are you working on for the science club?
lines.cn: 你在科学社团做什么项目?

lines.text: I'm studying how clean water can stop disease. The truth is that dirty water makes people ill.
lines.cn: 我在研究干净的水如何阻止疾病。事实是,脏水会让人生病。

lines.text: That sounds important. How will you test your idea?
lines.cn: 听起来很重要。你打算怎样检验你的想法?

lines.text: I'll collect evidence and repeat the test, because one result is never enough.
lines.cn: 我会收集证据并重复实验,因为一个结果远远不够。

grammarQuiz.q:
______ are also keen to learn about China.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

Laura, ______ daughter of my host family, wants Six months ago, 19-year-old Xie Lei said goodbye to study in China in the future.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

We take turns to to ______ family and friends and boarded a plane for cook each evening.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

They really love my ______-fried London.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Most doctors once thought cholera came from bad air. John Snow was not so sure. He marked every death on a map, saw they were close to one water pump, and proved that the dirty water was to blame. With nothing but a map and careful thinking, he changed the way diseases are studied.
reading.passageCn: 大多数医生曾以为霍乱来自坏空气。约翰·斯诺并不确定。他把每个死亡地点标在地图上,发现它们都靠近同一个水泵,从而证明了脏水才是元凶。仅凭一张地图和缜密的思考,他改变了人们研究疾病的方式。

questions.q: What did most doctors once think caused cholera?
How did Snow find the real cause?
opts: He marked the deaths on a map.

questions.q: What did Snow mainly use to solve the problem?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a scientist you admire. Say what he or she discovered and which quality of the scientific spirit you like most. Use at least one predicative clause (e.g. The truth is that ... / The reason is that ...).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一位你敬佩的科学家:他/她发现了什么,你最欣赏其哪种科学精神品质。至少用一个表语从句(如 The truth is that ... / The reason is that ...)。

quizQuestions.q: Scientists need ____ proof before they accept a new idea.
Snow showed a clear ____ between dirty water and disease.
People who drank ____ water were less likely to get cholera.
His work led to a ____ decrease in the threat of cholera.
The truth was ____ the water had been infected by waste.
Science is simply ____ you can do with curiosity.
The question is ____ we can reduce the cost of the vaccine.
The problem was ____ the team had enough time to test it.
听句子选中文:
quizQuestions.audio: He never stopped asking questions.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 天文学家用望远镜证明了他的理论。
quizQuestions.audio: Astronomers with telescopes proved his theory.

listeningQuestions.audio: Snow discovered that dirty water caused cholera.
opts: 斯诺发现脏水引起了霍乱。

listeningQuestions.audio: A real scientist always shares the results with others.
opts: 真正的科学家总会与他人分享成果。

listeningQuestions.audio: When the data look contradictory, we simply test again.
opts: 当数据看似矛盾时,我们就再做一次。

listeningQuestions.audio: Hawking was brave enough to admit his own faults.
opts: 霍金勇于承认自己的过错。

listeningQuestions.audio: Every great discovery began as a single curious question.
opts: 每个伟大的发现都始于一个好奇的问题。
发现都是靠运气得来的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Qian served his country with great effort and devotion.
opts: 钱学森满怀热忱地报效祖国。

finalReading.passage: When young Ben could not explain why his plant grew faster near the window, he did not simply accept it. He moved the plant around, wrote down what he saw each day, and asked his teacher for help. A month later, he proudly told the class that sunlight was the answer he had been looking for.

questions.q: What did Ben do when he could not explain his plant's growth?
options: He moved the plant, recorded what he saw, and asked for help.
He gave up and threw the plant away.
He stopped thinking about it at once.
He told everyone it was magic.
questions.explanation: 原文 'moved the plant around, wrote down what he saw each day, and asked his teacher for help' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What did Ben finally discover?
options: That the window was broken.
That sunlight made his plant grow faster.
That plants do not need light.
That his teacher was wrong.
questions.explanation: 末句 'sunlight was the answer he had been looking for'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

units.title: Bridging Cultures

lines.text: Welcome to our school! How do you feel so far?
lines.cn: 欢迎来到我们学校!到目前为止感觉怎么样?

lines.text: A little nervous, and I don't know what I should do first.
lines.cn: 有点紧张,我也不知道该先做什么。

lines.text: Don't worry. What I'd suggest is joining a club to make friends.
lines.cn: 别担心。我建议你加入一个社团来交朋友。

lines.text: That sounds great. Thank you for helping me adapt.
lines.cn: 听起来很好。谢谢你帮我适应。

lines.text: What part of Chinese culture would you like to learn?
lines.cn: 你想了解中国文化的哪一部分?

lines.text: Calligraphy. I love the idea that each character has a story.
lines.cn: 书法。我喜欢“每个汉字都有一个故事”这个想法。

lines.text: Then I'll teach you, and you can show me an Australian custom.
lines.cn: 那我来教你,你也可以给我介绍一个澳大利亚的习俗。

lines.text: Deal! Sharing like this is how we build a bridge.
lines.cn: 成交!像这样分享就是我们架起桥梁的方式。

units.grammarTitle: 名词性从句复习(主语/宾语/表语/同位语从句)

grammarQuiz.q:
"______, life," she said.

（健康话题语法 · 教材原句）

"I had to ______ how to use public XIE LEI!" transport and how to ask for things I didn't know the English names for.

（健康话题语法 · 教材原句）

When I got ______, I had to ask passers-by for help, but people here speak fast BUSINESS and use words I'm not familiar with.

（健康话题语法 · 教材原句）

"When I miss home, I ______

（健康话题语法 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Halfway through her exchange year, Xie Lei feels much more at home in Britain. What once seemed strange now appears quite normal. By sharing her own traditions and joining social activities, she has become a bridge between two cultures.
reading.passageCn: 交换年过半,谢蕾在英国感到自在多了。曾经陌生的事物如今显得十分平常。通过分享自己的传统、参与社交活动,她已成为连接两种文化的桥梁。

questions.q: How does Xie Lei feel now in Britain?
opts: Much more at home than before.

questions.q: How has Xie Lei become a bridge between cultures?
opts: By staying alone in her room.
By sharing traditions and joining activities.

writing.prompt: Write a short welcome message to exchange students coming to your school. Introduce one thing about your school and one part of Chinese culture you'd like to share.
writing.promptCn: 给来你校的交换生写一段欢迎短文:介绍你学校的一个特色,以及你想分享的一项中国文化(试着用名词性从句,如 What I want to share is…)。

quizQuestions.q: At first, Xie Lei had to ____ to a whole new life abroad.（适应)
Cooperating with others gives us more ____ into our own culture.（洞察)
Getting ____ in social activities helps overcome culture shock.（参与:get ___ in)
She is acting as a cultural ____ between China and the UK.（信使)
Her tutor said ____ she must acknowledge other people's ideas.
I don't know ____ the exchange student will arrive on time.
____ surprised Xie Lei was that she soon spoke up in class.
We must face the fact ____ adapting to a new culture is never easy.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 谢蕾正充当中英之间的文化桥梁。
quizQuestions.audio: Xie Lei is building a bridge between China and the UK.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他靠手机就能在外面付款。
quizQuestions.audio: He can pay for everything outside with just his phone.

listeningQuestions.audio: Xie Lei chose to live with a host family abroad.
opts: 谢蕾选择在国外与寄宿家庭一起生活。

listeningQuestions.audio: Getting involved in activities helps you overcome culture shock.
opts: 待在房间里最能克服文化冲击。
参与活动有助于你克服文化冲击。
文化冲击是无法克服的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Chinese students abroad can act as cultural envoys.
opts: 外国学生从不了解中国。
在国外的中国学生可以充当文化使者。

listeningQuestions.audio: She suffered from homesickness in her first weeks.
opts: 最初几周她饱受思乡之苦。

listeningQuestions.audio: Studying abroad can bring great pressure and high expenses.
opts: 出国留学会带来很大压力和高昂费用。
出国留学没有任何困难。

listeningQuestions.audio: Her tutor wanted to know what she herself thought.
opts: 导师想知道她自己的想法。

finalReading.passage: When Karim first came to China, he could barely use chopsticks and often felt like an outsider. Instead of giving up, he joined a cooking club and asked his classmates to teach him their favourite dishes. A year later, he could host a small dinner for his friends, and he felt proud that a little courage had turned strangers into a second family.

questions.q: How did Karim feel when he first arrived in China?
options: Like an outsider who could hardly use chopsticks.
Completely at home from the very first day.
Eager to leave the country at once.
Sure that he already knew everything.
questions.explanation: 原文 'could barely use chopsticks and often felt like an outsider' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What helped Karim change his situation?
options: He stayed alone and avoided everyone.
He joined a club and asked classmates to teach him.
He moved back to his own country.
He stopped eating Chinese food.
questions.explanation: 原文 'joined a cooking club and asked his classmates to teach him'(短文中段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Food and Culture

lines.text: I really love spicy food. What dish would you recommend?
lines.cn: 我很喜欢吃辣的。你会推荐哪道菜?

lines.text: You should try the steamed fish head covered with chillies.
lines.cn: 你应该试试剁椒鱼头。

lines.text: That sounds great. What else is good here?
lines.cn: 听起来很棒。这里还有什么好吃的?

lines.text: The red braised pork is the most famous dish in this restaurant.
lines.cn: 红烧肉是这家餐厅最有名的菜。

lines.text: How do you manage to stay so fit and full of energy?
lines.cn: 你是怎么保持这么健康、这么有活力的?

lines.text: I've cut down on sweet drinks and eat more fresh vegetables.
lines.cn: 我减少了甜饮料,多吃新鲜蔬菜。

lines.text: Does eating slowly really help?
lines.cn: 慢慢吃真的有用吗?

lines.text: Yes. It gives my brain time to know I'm full, so I never eat too much.
lines.cn: 有用。它让大脑有时间知道我饱了,所以我从不会吃太多。

units.grammarTitle: -ing 形式复习(动名词与现在分词)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ cuisine is a case in point.

（伦理与论证句型 · 教材原句）

Prior to ______ to China, my only experience with Chinese cooking was in America, with Chinese food that had been changed to suit American tastes.

（伦理与论证句型 · 教材原句）

For example, ______’s most popular Chinese dish is General Tso’s chicken, which consists of fried chicken covered in a sweet sauce, flavoured with hot red peppers.

（伦理与论证句型 · 教材原句）

This is probably not an ______ Chinese recipe, however, so it cannot tell us much about the Chinese.

（伦理与论证句型 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: In China, a meal is rarely just about food. When guests arrive, the host fills the table with dish after dish to show friendship and kindness. Sharing good food is one of the warmest ways to welcome a visitor.
reading.passageCn: 在中国,一顿饭很少只是为了吃。客人来时,主人会把一道道菜摆满餐桌,以表达友谊与善意。分享美食是欢迎来客最温暖的方式之一。

questions.q: What is a Chinese meal rarely only about?
Why does the host fill the table with dishes?

writing.prompt: Introduce a Chinese dish you like in about 60 words: its name and main ingredients, how it tastes, and the food culture behind it.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词介绍一道你喜欢的中国菜:名称与主要食材、味道,以及它背后的饮食文化。

quizQuestions.q: 菜肴、风味、烹饪,用哪个词?
(尤指烹饪)材料、成分,用哪个词?
适度、合理、节制,用哪个词?
厨师、主厨,用哪个词?
____ Chinese dishes at home is a great way to relax.
Be careful with the ____ water; it can burn your hand.
From the door I saw the chef ____ a huge pot of soup.
I still remember ____ that wonderful meal for the first time.
听句子选意思:
opts: 请问您准备好点菜了吗?
quizQuestions.audio: Are you ready to order, madam?

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选意思:
opts: 在中国北方,包饺子一直是全家人的事。
做饺子要一个人安静完成。
quizQuestions.audio: In the north of China, making dumplings has always been a family affair.

listeningQuestions.audio: Chinese cuisine changes greatly from place to place.
opts: 中国菜肴各地差异很大。
中国各地的菜完全一样。

listeningQuestions.audio: We usually eat boiled dumplings dipped in vinegar.
opts: 我们通常蘸醋吃水煮饺子。

listeningQuestions.audio: A balanced diet in moderation is the key to good health.
opts: 适度均衡的饮食是健康的关键。

listeningQuestions.audio: Eating slowly helps your body digest the food better.
opts: 慢慢吃有助于身体更好地消化食物。

listeningQuestions.audio: Through food, Chinese people show friendship and kindness.
opts: 中国人通过食物表达友谊与善意。
中国人很少用食物待客。
食物只是用来填饱肚子。

listeningQuestions.audio: The chef began filling our table with the best food.
opts: 厨师开始把最好的菜摆满我们的餐桌。
我们自己点了所有的菜。

finalReading.passage: When Tom first visited a Chinese friend's home, he was surprised to see the whole family making dumplings together around one table. At first he only watched, but soon everyone handed him some dough and taught him to wrap his own. By the end of the evening, his dumplings looked far from perfect, yet he had never felt more welcome.

questions.q: What surprised Tom when he first arrived?
options: The whole family was making dumplings together.
There was no food at all.
Everyone was eating in silence.
The family was watching television.
questions.explanation: 原文 'the whole family making dumplings together around one table' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Tom feel by the end of the evening?
options: Bored and tired.
Sorry that he had come.
More welcome than ever, despite his imperfect dumplings.
Angry that no one helped him.
questions.explanation: 末句 'his dumplings looked far from perfect, yet he had never felt more welcome'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Journey Across a Vast Land

lines.text: Wow, look at those snowy peaks heading west!
lines.cn: 哇,看西边那些雪山!

lines.text: Seen from the train, they look almost unreal, don't they?
lines.cn: 从火车上望去,它们几乎不像真的,对吧?

lines.text: They do. And there's a lake covered with ice down there.
lines.cn: 是啊。下面还有一个结着冰的湖。

lines.text: Anna says people skate on it in winter. This trip really takes my breath away.
lines.cn: 安娜说冬天人们在上面滑冰。这趟旅行真让我惊叹。

units.grammarTitle: 过去分词与 -ing 形式的对比(done vs doing)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ are also keen to learn about China.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

Laura, ______ daughter of my host family, wants Six months ago, 19-year-old Xie Lei said goodbye to study in China in the future.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

We take turns to to ______ family and friends and boarded a plane for cook each evening.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

They really love my ______-fried London.

（虚拟语气 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: When Daiyu's train finally reached the east coast, she had crossed the whole country by rail. Heading east, she had passed the great prairie, the snowy Rockies, and the busy city of Toronto. Tired but happy, she felt that the slow journey had been worth every single mile.
reading.passageCn: 当戴玉的火车终于抵达东海岸时,她已经坐火车横穿了整个国家。一路向东,她经过了辽阔的草原、雪山落基山和繁忙的多伦多。虽然疲惫却很快乐,她觉得这段慢旅程值得每一英里。

questions.q: How did Daiyu cross the country?
Which of these did Daiyu pass on the way?
opts: The prairie, the Rockies, and Toronto.

questions.q: How did Daiyu feel about the journey?
opts: She thought it was a waste of time.
She felt it was worth every mile.
She was too bored to remember it.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a journey you have taken or would like to take across a vast land. Describe the scenery and use at least one past participle or -ing form as an adverbial (e.g. Seen from …, / Heading east, …).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一段你曾经或想要进行的横穿辽阔大地的旅程:描述沿途风景,至少用一个过去分词或现在分词作状语(如 Seen from …, / Heading east, …)。

quizQuestions.q: From the train we watched a bunch of farms ____ a very large area.
The road ____ with deep snow was closed all winter.
____ from the hill, the lake looked deep blue in the morning light.
At the gate Liu Qian had her ticket ____ by a friendly officer.
The train sped across the great Canadian ____, where wheat grew for miles.
Snow still covered the high ____ of the Canadian Rockies.
The beauty of the lake took the visitors' ____ away.
Seeing the great falls, they were truly ____ by the rising mist.
听句子选中文:
opts: 他们坐了四天的火车才横穿这个国家。
他们坐飞机几小时就到了。
quizQuestions.audio: It took them four days by train to cross the whole country.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 蒙特利尔的人只说英语。
在蒙特利尔,大多数人既说英语又说法语。
蒙特利尔没有人会说英语。
蒙特利尔的人都说中文。
quizQuestions.audio: In Montreal, most people speak both English and French.

listeningQuestions.audio: The train headed east across the great Canadian prairie.
opts: 火车向东驶过辽阔的加拿大大草原。
火车在城市里慢慢停下。
火车爬上了高高的雪山。
火车沿着海岸向南行驶。

listeningQuestions.audio: In winter the lake freezes over, and people skate on the thick ice.
opts: 冬天湖水变暖,可以游泳。
冬天湖面结冰,人们在厚冰上滑冰。

listeningQuestions.audio: Seen from the top of the hill, the autumn forest looked like a painting.
opts: 从山顶望去,秋天的森林一片灰暗。
从山顶望去,森林正在燃烧。
从山顶望去,秋天的森林像一幅画。
从山顶望去,什么也看不见。

listeningQuestions.audio: In Montreal the signs and advertisements were all written in French.
opts: 在蒙特利尔人们只说英语。
在蒙特利尔没有任何标识。
在蒙特利尔标识都是中文。
在蒙特利尔标识和广告都是用法语写的。

listeningQuestions.audio: The slow journey across the vast land became a memory for life.
opts: 这段横穿辽阔大地的慢旅程成了一生的记忆。
这段旅程让人很快忘记。
这段旅程只是浪费时间。
这段旅程很快就结束了。

listeningQuestions.audio: More than a hundred years ago, many of the railway workers came from China.
opts: 铁路是机器自己修好的。
一百多年前,许多铁路工人来自中国。
铁路工人都来自附近的小镇。
铁路是一个夏天就建成的。

finalReading.passage: On the last morning of their long rail trip, Daiyu and Liu Qian woke to find the train speeding alongside the sea. After four days of forests, prairie, and snowy peaks, they could hardly believe how far they had come. Tired but happy, they agreed that the slow journey across such a vast land had been worth every single mile.

questions.q: What did the girls see when they woke on the last morning?
options: The train was running beside the sea.
The train had broken down in the mountains.
They were still crossing the prairie.
Heavy snow covered the windows.
questions.explanation: 原文 'woke to find the train speeding alongside the sea' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: How did the two girls feel about the journey?
options: They wished they had taken a plane.
They thought it had been a waste of time.
They felt the long trip was worth every mile.
They were too bored to remember it.
questions.explanation: 末句 'the slow journey … had been worth every single mile' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: First Aid

lines.text: My friend has burnt her arm badly. What should I do?
lines.cn: 我朋友的胳膊被严重烫伤了,我该怎么办?

lines.text: Stay calm. Put her arm under cool running water first.
lines.cn: 保持冷静。先把她的胳膊放在凉的流动水下冲。

lines.text: Should I put anything on it?
lines.cn: 我要在上面抹点什么吗?

lines.text: No, don't use oil. Just cover it loosely and take her to hospital if it's serious.
lines.cn: 不,别用油。只要宽松地盖住,如果严重就送她去医院。

units.grammarTitle: 过去完成时及其被动语态(had done / had been done)

reading.passage: Tom was eating quickly when a piece of meat got stuck in his throat and he could not breathe. Luckily, his friend Sam had learned the Heimlich manoeuvre at school. Sam stood behind him, pushed up into his stomach, and the food was soon forced out.
reading.passageCn: Tom 吃得太快,一块肉卡在喉咙里,无法呼吸。幸好他的朋友 Sam 在学校学过海姆立克急救法。Sam 站到他身后向上推压腹部,食物很快就被推了出来。

questions.q: What happened to Tom?
opts: A piece of meat got stuck in his throat.
He burnt his hand on a pan.

questions.q: How was Sam able to help?
opts: He had learned the Heimlich manoeuvre at school.

questions.q: What did Sam do to save Tom?
opts: He laid Tom on the floor.
He stood behind Tom and pushed up into his stomach.

writing.prompt: In about 60 words, explain the first three steps you would take to give first aid for a burn.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词说明你处理烧伤时会先做的三个急救步骤。

quizQuestions.q: '紧急的、急迫的'对应哪个词?
海姆立克法中'握成拳头'用哪个词?make a ____
'(突然)倒下、昏倒'用哪个动词?
'减轻疼痛'中'减轻'用哪个动词?____ the pain
When the doctor arrived, the man ____ breathing.
The wound ____ before the nurse bandaged it.
By the time help came, the boy ____ first aid to his grandfather.
No sooner had he swallowed it ____ he began to choke.
听句子选中文:
opts: 伤者已经被送往医院了。
quizQuestions.audio: The victim had already been taken to hospital.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 急救时要保持冷静,别惊慌。
急救应该交给别人去做。
quizQuestions.audio: When you give first aid, stay calm and do not panic.

listeningQuestions.audio: Place a burn under cool running water for about ten minutes.
opts: 把烧伤处放在凉的流动水下冲约十分钟。
把烧伤处放在阳光下晒十分钟。
在烧伤处抹上一层黄油。
烧伤后立刻用力揉搓皮肤。

listeningQuestions.audio: Never put oil on a burn, because it keeps the heat in.
opts: 烧伤后一定要马上抹油。
绝不要在烧伤处抹油,因为它会把热留住。
抹油能让烧伤更快好转。
油能立刻带走伤口的热量。

listeningQuestions.audio: If a person is choking, stand behind them and push up into the stomach.
opts: 有人噎住时,应让他自己慢慢吞咽。
有人噎住时,只需给他喝水。
若有人噎住,站到他身后向上推压腹部。
有人噎住时,应使劲拍他的头。

listeningQuestions.audio: Stay calm and call an ambulance when someone collapses.
opts: 有人昏倒时应先离开现场。
有人昏倒时要大声尖叫很久。
有人昏倒时把他抬起来摇晃。
有人昏倒时要保持冷静并叫救护车。

listeningQuestions.audio: A first-degree burn touches only the top layer of the skin.
opts: 一度烧伤只伤及皮肤的最上层。
一度烧伤是最严重的一种。
一度烧伤必须立刻手术。

listeningQuestions.audio: Keep the first-aid kit somewhere that is easy to find.
opts: 急救箱应锁起来,不让人找到。
把急救箱放在容易找到的地方。
急救箱里只放钱和钥匙。

finalReading.passage: When Lily saw her neighbour fall and stop moving, she did not panic. She quickly called an ambulance and stayed on the line while the operator told her how to help. By the time the paramedics arrived, the old man had begun to breathe steadily again, and Lily felt proud that her calm action had made a difference.

questions.q: How did Lily react when her neighbour fell?
options: She stayed calm and called an ambulance.
She ran away in fear.
She did nothing and waited.
She carried him to hospital alone.
questions.explanation: 原文 'she did not panic. She quickly called an ambulance' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Lily feel after the paramedics arrived?
options: Sorry that she had helped.
Bored and tired.
Glad that staying calm had truly mattered.
Afraid of the old man.
questions.explanation: 末句 'Lily felt proud that her calm action had made a difference'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
